verdict.rationale: Reducto's docs show its entire functional surface — parse, extract, split, route, edit, multi-step workflows, webhooks, citations, chunking — exposed as documented API endpoints (openapi.json) plus CLI and MCP interfaces mirroring the same capabilities, indicating the Studio UI is a thin layer over the API rather than a separate feature set (reducto-probe-rt-2, reducto-docs-6, reducto-docs-28). No evidence surfaces a UI-only capability inaccessible via API. Missing for 10: an explicit vendor statement of 1:1 UI/API parity and independent confirmation that no Studio-exclusive feature exists.
